The holiday half of the tour

Sun, sea, links golf and nine nights to enjoy it.

After six nights in Wales and England, the pace changes. Lykia World sits on the Belek coast with its own links course, pools and restaurants. It's Super All Inclusive, so golfers and non-golfers can switch off and enjoy the resort.
